answer: We implement a slashing matrix governed by zero-knowledge reputation commitments that act as a digital garden to prune malicious actors. This protocol enforces a willow structure of trust where autonomous agents must lock capital to initiate a voyage of cross-shard verification. By mapping identity to stake-weighted entropy, an attacker faces negative expected utility and prohibitive lockup. This equilibrium sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance by ensuring consensus costs exceed the potential damage.
